item.title: Under Trump, NIH funding disruptions have evolved. Here's what the numbers show
item.description: Stories of science funding being cut, labs shutting down and scientists losing jobs have flooded the media under Trump's administration. These six graphics show how those changes have affected U.S. biomedical research.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: The Education Dept. hasn't been dismantled. It's become more inefficient, staff say
item.description: Education staff are being scattered across several other federal agencies. Despite the Trump administration's claims, employees say it's adding bureaucracy and making it harder to serve students.
item.content:encoded:

item.description: The investigations by attorneys general follow a recent bankruptcy filing in the face of civil lawsuits, falling revenues, and impending debt payments.

item.title: eBay bans airbag sales as concerns about faulty or counterfeit parts rise
item.description: eBay became the latest online retailer to ban the sale of airbags and many of their components. Aftermarket parts can be risky if they turn out to be fake or defective.

item.title: Warren demands Trump officials explain removing a ban on interference in census data
item.description: Democratic Sen. Elizabeth Warren asked Trump officials to explain why the Census Bureau's parent agency cut a ban on political interference from its scientific integrity policy, as NPR first reported.

item.title: Judge orders Trump administration to restore journalists' access to White House
item.description: A federal judge ordered the Trump administration on Thursday to temporarily restore access to CNN, MS NOW and Politico, after they were banned from covering White House events by President Trump.

item.title: Venezuela's acting leader promises elections at the 'right moment'
item.description: Venezuela's acting president, delivering her first address to the U.N. General Assembly since coming to power, promised elections and said the nation's people will determine the "right moment."

item.title: OpenAI's breach of Australian health department website prompts rebuke
item.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said he was extremely concerned about OpenAI 's breach of an Australian health department website that the artificial intelligence company took too long to reveal.

item.title: Fears of return to war grow in Ethiopia's Tigray region
item.description: Fears are growing of a return to war in Ethiopia's Tigray region, just four years after a devastating conflict ended in a fragile peace deal.

item.title: Hurricane Polo fuels fears of landslides in Mexico as Nolo closes in on Hawaii
item.description: Southwestern Mexico braced for heavy rain and mudslides after Polo became a major hurricane. Forecasters warned another system headed for Hawaii could cause catastrophic flooding later in the week.
